summary: Slide has science and answer leak issues but no text/image/overlap problems.
readability_issues: The instruction text 'Now write the same word in the last box of your model.' appears smaller than main content text, potentially hard to read from back of classroom.
science_issues: The slide states 'When you see a change, you are seeing evidence of energy' but the model flow (ENERGY → CHANGE → EVIDENCE) incorrectly separates 'evidence' from 'change', as the change itself is the evidence of energy (so the model should end with 'CHANGE', not 'EVIDENCE').
answer_leak: The word 'evidence' is highlighted in the text 'you are seeing evidence of energy', revealing the answer students are supposed to write in the last box of their model.
